maya (newhire): hey! first-week CI question — i opened a PR from my fork and the GitHub Actions workflow shows "skipped: workflows are disabled for this repo". i followed the onboarding doc but not sure what i missed.
ryan (infra): welcome, maya. forks often hit that because org policy blocks workflows from forks. do you see a banner in the Actions tab that says policies are enforced?
maya (newhire): yes a red banner: "Organization policies prevent workflows from running on forked PRs. Contact repo admins."
claire (devex): for onboarding we allow a special flow: either 1) push a branch to the redwood-inference repo (we give a temporary dev branch), or 2) request a one-off allowance from infra to enable workflows for that forked PR. 
maya (newhire): is there a self-serve checkbox somewhere? i looked at Settings > Actions but the repo options are greyed out.
ryan (infra): that's SAML/SO and org-level enforcement. repo-level toggles are disabled because we require `Allow local and reusable workflows` only via org policy. i'll add you to the `ci-onboarding` team which lets us grant a temporary workflow allowance. send the PR link.
maya (newhire): https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7 Thanks! also the workflow logs say: `Error: Resource not accessible by integration` when the checkout step runs. curious if it's related.
claire (devex): yep, that's the classic token scope issue. the checkout action uses the PR token which for forks doesn't have write:packages or workflows:write. our workaround for onboarding is to opt into the `gha-bot` runner which uses org-level OIDC credentials.
gha-bot: Received request to run workflow for PR #7 from maya (newhire). Confirmed: org allowance pending approval.
ryan (infra): approved the allowance for that PR. gha-bot should re-run. note: we only grant this for onboarding repos and it's time-limited.
gha-bot: Workflow re-run scheduled. Matching self-hosted runners available.
maya (newhire): it started! now failing on `make test` because of missing env var LOCAL_KV_URL in the action. docs mention `secrets.ONBOARDING_LOCAL_KV` but it's not available to forks.
claire (devex): i'll inject a repo-level variable for the onboarding pipeline (masked) for this run. long-term, update tests to support a dockerized in-memory kv for CI.
maya (newhire): pushed a small test change to default to in-memory when LOCAL_KV_URL is unset and re-ran — all green 389. thanks everyone, this was super fast.
ryan (infra): welcome aboard! ping #devex if you want a quick walkthrough of Actions policies, runner tags, and the onboarding checklist.
